[SWS_SM_00675] ErrorCode for failed creation of a StateMachine of type Agent
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
If the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
detects an error during creation of a
StateMachine
of type
Agent
, the configured
startAgentError
mapped to the
affected
StateMachine
shall be used as ErrorCode in the
Controller Error-
RecoveryTable
.
⌋
